name: Ambient Intelligence Layer for Investment Finance

mentions.name: Ambient Intelligence Layer for Investment Finance
mentions.description: A personal ambient intelligence layer for investment finance, featuring a 3-tiered memory architecture, sensors for environment scanning, skills, reasoning agents, and a new agentic UI concept built specifically for that purpose. Inspired by OpenClaw, which the author considers overhyped.
